purpose: Frozen-policy robustness screen, NOT checkpoint or hyperparameter selection. 11520 games = 5760 paired seat comparisons from 1440 distinct deal/opponent seeds. Same seeds/seats for selected and teacher, independent seeds across opponent styles. All-seat repeats are clustered by deal in uncertainty estimates. No final seeds, no production qualification; no frozen-1 neural reference yet.
failurePolicy: Retain zero-credit failures in denominator and block passing the screen; never use this data for optimizer updates.
storage: Compact outcomes only, no observations/trajectories; private HF, checkpointed every 240 games, 128 MiB artifact budget.
